claim_policy.experimental_results: Must remain grounded in the frozen experimental evidence, not literature sources.
claim_policy.first_or_novel_claims: Do not make priority claims unless literature evidence supports them.
claim_policy.research_gap: State only after systematic comparison of retrieved prior work.

evidence_domains.domain: 3GPP network slicing management and intent management

Determine whether prior work provides an end-to-end, source-preserving, deterministic failure-containment path from natural-language intent to executable slice artifacts.

inclusion_policy.preferred: Peer-reviewed journal/conference papers and authoritative standards/technical specifications.
inclusion_policy.secondary_surveys: Allowed for landscape discovery but primary papers should support specific technical claims where available.
inclusion_policy.standards: Official 3GPP and O-RAN sources required for normative claims.
inclusion_policy.unverified_web_sources: Not sufficient as final evidence for technical or normative claims.

research_topic: Deterministic natural-language intent translation for 3GPP- and O-RAN-aligned network slicing
